institution: Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar
citation: Department of Microbiology, Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Soura, Srinagar. Antibiogram for the year 2022. Srinagar: SKIMS; 2023.
reporting: Percent susceptible by organism, specimen (blood; pus and body fluids; urine) and location (IPD, OPD, ICU), with n per location; organism isolation tables by specimen and location.
method: Testing according to CLSI M100, 32nd ed. (2022); species with test data for fewer than 30 isolates generally excluded (as stated).

verification.note: Six susceptibility tables (pages 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11; drug headers and organism labels are rotated, so the column order was taken from the rendered pages) parsed from the PDF text layer by word position inside the ruled grid (pdfplumber), then every cell compared by eye with the pages rendered at scale 2.7 to 3.2 and cropped into halves; organism tables (pages 3, 6, 9) checked on the images (2026-09-26). A blind re-read of 6 random cells (value read from a crop of header and row before looking at the extracted value) found no differences.

notes: Specimen-wise antibiogram with each organism split by IPD (wards), OPD and ICU. "Pus & body fluids" is recorded as pus, wounds and body fluids. Cells printed as "-", "IR" or left blank are left out; values printed as 0 are recorded as 0. Ticarcillin + clavulanate columns have no drug key and are left out. Enterococcus gentamicin in blood is printed with an unexplained asterisk (25*, 20*) and recorded as gentamicin. Footnotes say all isolates were susceptible to colistin (blood, except Burkholderia) and to polymyxin B (pus and urine, except Proteus); these are not table values and are not recorded. The file name says 2023 but the report is titled "Antibiogram for the year 2022". Downloaded from the Wayback Machine snapshot web.archive.org/web/20260413013839id_/ of the URL (the SKIMS server refuses scripted downloads).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 749 cells of the six susceptibility tables (pages 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11; the seeded sample of 187 plus every other cell), all 63 row n with their IPD/OPD/ICU labels and all 84 organism-table counts (pages 3, 6, 9) re-read against the page images (scale 3, tables cropped into halves or quadrants), each value read before comparing. 0 transcription errors in values, n, settings, organisms or counts; no value corrected.

Cells not kept by the rules, re-read and printed as recorded: Enterococcus gentamicin in blood (25* and 20*, asterisk unexplained), pus (56.5, 0, 0) and urine (79.6, 73.9, 50) and Pseudomonas pus ampicillin-sulbactam (3.1, 9.7, 0) and ceftriaxone (10.3, 22.2, 0) (intrinsic); cautions: blood Enterococcus ICU vancomycin 49.8 (n=39); blood Klebsiella IPD ceftriaxone 9.8 (n=34); blood Pseudomonas ICU piperacillin-tazobactam 18, ceftazidime 6, aztreonam 6, doripenem 7 (n=10); blood Salmonella IPD ceftriaxone 98 (n=16); blood Enterobacter IPD piperacillin-tazobactam 53 and ciprofloxacin 47 (n=12) and ICU gentamicin 48, cefoperazone-sulbactam 73, piperacillin-tazobactam 47, ciprofloxacin 35, levofloxacin 54, imipenem 73 (n=8); blood B. cepacia IPD levofloxacin 94 (n=10); urine Proteus cefotaxime and ceftriaxone 20 and 60 (IPD), 33.3 and 83.3 (OPD).

Count mismatch confirmed as printed: the blood Gram-negative table (page 5) prints Enterobacter IPD (n=12) and ICU (n=8), while the blood organism table (page 3) gives 11 IPD, 0 OPD and 9 ICU (total 20 in both); kept as printed with the row notes. The two amikacin cells left out are printed that way on page 8: E. coli pus IPD "701" and Acinetobacter pus ICU "3.63.8".

Also confirmed: the n=0 rows (blood OPD except Salmonella, Salmonella ICU, urine S. aureus and Klebsiella ICU) print only "-"; the pus Gram-negative group labels print Klebsiella spp. (n=548) and Proteus spp. (n=64) while their location n add up to 550 and 67, as in the organism table (rows use the location n). Added a note to the three pus Proteus rows, whose n equal the combined Proteus spp./Morganella/Providencia organism-table row. No black or grey cell markers in this report (grey and coloured fills are row banding or headers, IR is printed as text), so no marker was recorded as 0. Institution reads "Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences, Srinagar"; the Wayback PDF is complete (11 pages, ends with %%EOF).
